mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate is held constant above 5.25% for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 forward 60-day return tends to be negative due to persistent higher discount rates eroding expected equity payoffs.
failure_condition: Over a 60-day horizon, SPX forward returns are not statistically different from a zero-move baseline (p > 0.05) during qualifying rate holds.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly decline in CPIAUCSL by at least 0.3% followed by a stabilization signals disinflation, which is associated with a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates rate cuts.
failure_condition: During qualifying CPI drops, 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When monthly GDPC1 (real private consumption) exceeds INDPRO by at least 2% for two consecutive months, it indicates strong consumer demand, which predicts a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > INDPRO * 1.02 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: Over the 5-day horizon, forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during qualifying demand outperformance.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in PAYEMS by at least 10,000 jobs in a single month is associated with a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return, reflecting optimism about labor market resilience and growth.
failure_condition: During such job spikes, 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO falls by more than 5% from one month to the next, it signals supply-side weakness, which tends to produce a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates slower growth.
failure_condition: Over the 60-day window following the contraction, forward returns are not significantly worse than a zero-move baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of RSAFS above 700,000 and HOUST above 1,300 suggest robust industrial and consumer demand, which is associated with a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 700000 AND HOUST > 1300 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: During qualifying demand double-tops, 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in UNRATE below 3.5% for three consecutive months is a regime shift toward lower labor market pressure, which predicts a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: During such rate declines, 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.25% in a single month during a period of rising CPIAUCSL, it signals tightening policy and is associated with a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate slower growth.
failure_condition: During qualifying policy tightening with inflation rising, 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
